who: Security engineers need a way to validate agent behavior in isolated environments without risking their own machines or sensitive data.
agent_work: An agent runs tasks inside a Celesto sandbox, executes commands with safety hooks and network policy, records all actions in an audit log, and recovers from mid-task failure by applying a named policy.
proof_output: A containment report and reliability metrics showing the sandbox held when attacked, along with a clean run ledger entry proving execution_target is celesto_sandbox.
